channel.title: Lie Detector: Truth or Deception
channel.desc: Matheau Moore sits down for a polygraph test with former FBI agent George Olivo, hoping to clear his name; though he was found not guilty of murdering his wife, Emily Noble in 2022, suspicions still follow him, even among those closest to the case; will the results finally put lingering doubts to rest, or stir up new questions?
